subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Cyber Threats to the Grid
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Cyber Threats to the Grid.

hook.text: In 2015, hackers took down Ukraine's power grid remotely — 230,000 people lost power.

buildup.text: Grid control systems use SCADA networks. Many were designed before cybersecurity existed.

discovery.text: Attackers can open breakers, disable alarms, and lock operators out simultaneously.

twist.text: Air-gapping critical systems helps, but USB drives and insider threats bypass it.

climax.text: Governments now classify the power grid as critical infrastructure requiring military-grade defense.

punchline.text: The grid's weakest link might be a password, not a wire.

quiz.question: What made the 2015 Ukraine grid attack possible?
options: Hackers remotely accessed SCADA control systems to open breakers
A software update crashed all the generators at once
